source:
@@U04108@@
We come here, Sire,
hoping we're not unwelcome.
Foresight can be a good thing,
even when not needed.
As you know,
the mountain people are well versed
in the lore of nature and rocks.
The spirits who once lived on the low plains
have left there now, more attracted
than ever to mountain ranges.
It’s there they work quietly in cavernous labyrinths,
surrounded by precious gases of metallic vapors,
testing, separating, combining—
with one only purpose:
to discover the not-yet-discovered.
With subtle power of mind
they create transparent forms,
and then in the ever-silent depths of the crystal
they read of events in the upper world.

@@U04110@@
Yes, so I’ve heard, and I believe you.
But why, my good man,
should it interest me now?

@@U04112@@
I remind you, Sire, of the
Sabine necromancer of Norcia,
your ever-faithful and devoted servant.
What a dreadful fate once threatened him!
Twigs crackled, kindling,
flames had begun licking upward,
dry logs placed crosshatch around,
mingled with pitch and sticks of sulfur—
neither man, God, nor Devil could have saved him;
except for Your Majesty who burst those chains of fire.
translation:
@@U04108@@
我们来到这里，陛下，
希望我们不会不受欢迎。
有远见可能是件好事
即使不需要时。
如你所知，
山里人都精通
在自然和岩石的传说中。
曾经生活在低地平原上的精灵
现在已经离开那里，更加吸引
比以往任何时候都更接近山脉。
他们在那里的洞穴迷宫中安静地工作，
被金属蒸气的珍贵气体包围，
测试、分离、组合——
只有一个目的：
去发现尚未发现的事物。
凭借微妙的心灵力量
他们创造透明的形式，
然后在水晶永远寂静的深处
他们读到了上层世界的事件。

@@U04110@@
是的，我听说过，而且我相信你。
但为什么，我的好人，
我现在应该感兴趣吗？

@@U04112@@
陛下，我提醒您
诺尔恰的萨宾死灵法师，
您永远忠实和忠诚的仆人。
曾经有多么可怕的命运威胁着他！
树枝噼啪作响，点燃，
火焰开始向上蔓延，
周围放置交叉影线的干原木，
与沥青和硫磺棒混合——
无论是人、上帝还是魔鬼都无法拯救他；
除了摧毁那些火链的陛下。
